text:
marta: Putting a pin on the 2.14.0 release notes draft — small runtime perf + routing fallback tweaks. Need docs/ops/legal sign-off by EOD PT so I can pin and set the deploybot annotations. Planned pin: 2024-12-28 17:00 PT. Deploy window: 2024-12-29 02:00-06:00 UTC. Who can run the final smoke and cover APAC/EU routing checks? :calendar:
jen: From docs: please include an explicit "version pin (artifact SHA)" line and a one-liner about the `truncate` param behavior change. I'll drop a curl snippet into the draft. Also prefer we show times in UTC + PT on the pinned blurb.
sam: Ops ask: add rollback criteria and exact revert tag. Proposal: rollback if client error rate > 1.5% sustained for 7m OR p95 token latency delta > 170ms sustained for 10m. Revert tag: `revert/2.14.0`. Add the step-by-step revert commands to the runbook.
rachel: I can run US+EU smoke (01:30-03:30 UTC). Smoke checklist: health checks, 4 sample generations (short/long/edge), 3 embedding checks, KV warming, and an EU routing-fallback sanity test. I will paste logs here and call revert if fallback fails.
deploy-bot: INFO: Canary plan uploaded: 3% -> 25% -> 40% -> 100% with 10m ramps. Auto-rollback thresholds: canary error delta > 1.2% OR p95 latency delta > 160ms vs baseline. Command preview: `/deploy start v2.14.0 --canary=3,25,40 --ramp=10m --annotations=\"internal-announce:autopost,ops-runbook:attached\"`
marta: Thanks — added rollback criteria and revert tag to the draft, plus a short Dedicated FAQ line about quiesce during model swaps (example pinned artifact sha: d4e5f6a). Draft link: https://docs.internal/releases/2.14.0-draft (please comment inline). I set autopost to trigger at the 40% canary so comms has more signal before the manual follow.
jen: Added curl example:
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"rwd-compact-2","input":"status","truncate":true}'
```
And a tiny wording tweak around "version pin (artifact)".
sam: Ill own the internal announce cadence. Plan: autopost to `internal-announce` at 40% and manual follow-up at 100% if stable. Will include ops runbook bullets and an explicit ping list (ops-rotation, eng-oncall, legal-team). Also will localize one-liners for APAC/EU.
rachel: Smoke checklist approved. Ill run tests and post timestamps/logs here. If anything anomalous, I will trigger `revert/2.14.0` and notify ops-rotation.
deploy-bot: SCHEDULED: Deploy scheduled to start 2024-12-29T02:00:00Z. Manifest `manifest-2.14.0.json` attached. Canary annotations saved (autopost at 40%).
marta: Great. If no objections I will pin the draft at 2024-12-28 17:00 PT and flip the deploybot annotation to `internal-announce:autopost`. Please thumbs up when you've reviewed.
jen: :thumbsup: docs OK.
sam: :thumbsup: comms ready, will post localized lines.
rachel: :thumbsup: ready to run smoke and will paste logs.
marta: Pinning now and will monitor the canary steps. Thanks team — fingers crossed for a clean roll. :crossed_fingers:
